hook: AND, OR, NOT: SQL ka [[relationship status]]

slides.title: Teen [[rishte]]
slides.note: AND = strict rishta 💍, OR = chill dost 😎, NOT = ex 🙅

slides.title: IT [[aur]] Delhi
slides.code:
SELECT *
FROM employees
WHERE dept = 'IT'
  AND city = 'Delhi';

slides.title: AND ka [[result]]
slides.note: Riya bhi IT hai, par **Pune** mein. AND ne bahar kar diya 🚪

slides.title: NOT ka [[ulta]] game
points: NOT IN, NOT LIKE, IS NOT NULL bhi

slides.title: Mix karo? [[Bracket]] lagao
slides.code:
SELECT *
FROM employees
WHERE (dept = 'IT'
    OR dept = 'HR')
  AND city = 'Delhi';
slides.note: **AND pehle** chalta hai, OR baad mein. Jaise maths mein × pehle, + baad mein

slides.wrong:
WHERE dept = 'IT'
   OR dept = 'HR'
  AND city = 'Delhi'
slides.why: Bina bracket: IT **ya** (HR+Delhi). Pune wali **Riya** bhi aa gayi 😵

points: Mix kiya? **( ) lagao**, AND pehle chalta
